payload.core_mechanism_summary: Linear scan over integer x from 1 upwards, computing y algebraically from H(x,y)=r, stopping at first valid pair.
payload.rationale: Among candidate subtypes, search_permutation_enumeration is the closest fit as it represents brute-force enumeration of possibilities, even though the solution enumerates x values rather than permutations. No other subtype (graph, branch&bound, backtracking, bitmask) matches the simple linear search.
